traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.text:
The elven scout has advantage on
saving throws against being charmed, and magic
can’t put them to sleep.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
traits.text:
The elven scout has advantage
on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on
hearing or sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
The elven scout makes two melee attacks
or two ranged attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach
5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 +2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.text:
Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, ranged
150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 +2) piercing
damage.
